notes: Local guidance: favours mid to high tide with higher swell. Published school guidance also identifies mid tide. Rocky bottom. West and south-west swell preferred. The owner's 283° guidance refers to Surfline and is not a universal GFS cut-off. Raw provider bearings are unchanged. This supersedes earlier direction guidance only; separate tide, size and experience settings remain. Based on local knowledge and forecast comparisons, pending measured beach observations.
